tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The dark ground and the eyes of every worker. Letters of the wordmark on paper. Text on any triad fill.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The light ground. Letters of the wordmark on ink. Body text on ink (16.6:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Only inside the source wordmark for a white ground; never a UI ground. Prefer paper.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: The workers in the one-colour wordmark. Not a text colour (2.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The actor: running, selected, focus, links on ink (6.4:1). A fill on any ground with ink text.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The accent and the fail signal: buttons, focus ring, the default mark, errors on ink (4.9:1). As text on paper only at 19px bold or larger (3.4:1); otherwise pink-deep.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The pass signal: verified, ready, ok on ink (12.7:1). Never text on paper (1.3:1); use green-deep.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Blue at text strength on paper (4.6:1): links and the active state in the light theme.

tokens.name: pink-deep
tokens.usage: Pink at text strength on paper (4.5:1): the accent as text and the fail state in the light theme.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Green at text strength on paper (4.6:1): the pass state in the light theme.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Link hover on ink.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Accent fill on hover, both themes; ink text stays legible (6:1).

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: A lighter green for hover on green fills.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: A panel or window one step off the ground: the terminal body, cards.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Two steps off the ground: a hovered row, a selected step, a window's title bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders on controls and windows; ghost buttons.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: nav links, step text, table cells on bg and surface (10:1 dark, 9:1 light).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta, captions, the tagline, disabled text on bg and surface (6.8:1 dark, 5.1:1 light).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg and surface.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The accent as a fill in both themes: primary buttons, the progress bar, the favicon. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text on bg and surface: ghost-button hover, an emphasised word.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, ok-fill, fail-fill and active-fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs meaning verified, pass, ready, approve.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs meaning refused, failed, blocked, error.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs meaning running, selected, in focus.

tokens.name: ok-fill
tokens.usage: A pass state as a fill (pill, bar, worker) with on-accent text.

tokens.name: fail-fill
tokens.usage: A fail state as a fill with on-accent text.

tokens.name: active-fill
tokens.usage: A running or selected state as a fill with on-accent text: the TUI status line, the selected row.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection ground, with on-selection text.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Selected text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 3px, on every ground (4.9:1 on ink, 3.4:1 on paper).

families.mono: "Fira Code", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one sentence under the wordmark. Clamps to 32px on a phone.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: af is a multi-agent coding factory for Git repositories.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reviewers and implementers only ever mutate a sandbox and return typed artifacts; only the kernel integrates.
styles.usage: Running copy. The site clamps 15px to 17px with the viewport.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Open source · Apache-2.0 · macOS and Linux
styles.usage: Captions, the tagline, footers, in muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands and recorded output. Ligatures off, so -> and && show what was typed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid. Gaps inside a chip or between a glyph and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; padding inside small chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page gutter on a phone; gap between siblings.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its body; terminal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The page gutter on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Clear space around the wordmark; gap between hero blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding, small screens.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding, desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything pixel: the mark, the workers, progress bars, the wordmark's panel in README banners.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, the focus ring, the header mark.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the terminal window.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: 3 of 16 cells: the ink tile behind the mark in app icons.
